name: Navi

notes: Were reportedly searching for a child whose mother died while the child survived, according to the journal described by Sylan.
The Mother's Prayer is described as a sacred tradition among the Navi.
Historically used the prophecy to identify individuals who would aid their exploration and protection of Atlas.
Very few Navi remain alive today according to Plymouth.
Treat the Mother's Prayer as a sacred tradition.
Historically used the prophecy to identify individuals who would aid their exploration of Atlas.
State that very few Navi remain.
Keystone keepers are considered honorary members of the Navi by virtue of becoming Children of the Great Eldarin Tree.
Honorary membership can be bestowed upon outsiders.
A Child of the Tree is accepted as a brother among them.

openQuestions: Why were the Navi searching for this child?
